subject: Security discovery: data processing map + cloud vendor confirmation
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acehealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-demo questions: SOC 2 / subprocessors / data residency

Thanks for the demo today — good overview. Before we lock in the pilot, legal and infra have a few items we need clarified. Can you help confirm the following?

1) SOC 2 status: do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If yes, what period does it cover and is there an NDA process to share?
2) Subprocessors: can you provide a full list of subprocessors (cloud infra, telemetry, monitoring, analytics) and which ones see plaintext user data vs encrypted tokens only?
3) Data residency: does Redwood support EU data processing or customer-controlled VPCs for data-at-rest?
4) Questionnaire: we will send a short vendor security questionnaire and need a point of contact to complete it.

If we can get those answers this week we can move procurement forward.

—Alex
Alex Gomez
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations
AceHealth
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acehealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo questions: SOC 2 / subprocessors / data residency

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Recap and next steps below so everyone is aligned. I attached a current subprocessor export and our security factsheet to speed review.

Recap / immediate answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) for period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. We can share a redacted report under an NDA.
- Subprocessors: attached: redwood_subprocessors_20261130.csv — contains vendor name, role, region, and data type processed (column: plaintext_token_access = yes/no). Please review specific rows you want clarified.
- Data residency: Hosted API processes in us-east-1 by default; we offer Dedicated and Private (VPC) deployments for EU residency. We can map your pilot to our EU region or propose a Private deployment if required.
- Questionnaire: please send your vendor questionnaire to security-requests@redwood.com. Marcus will own the completion and Priyom will confirm any required follow-on items for procurement.

Proposed timeline:
1) You send questionnaire (today/tomorrow) — security-requests@redwood.com + cc lauren.bishop@redwood.com
2) Marcus to return questionnaire answers + SOC 2 NDA share (48 hours after receipt)
3) Map any flagged subprocessors and agree on DPA addendum (by Friday 12/04)
4) Follow-up call if needed (I suggested two 30-min slots below)

Attachments (stubs): redwood_subprocessors_20261130.csv (CSV, 42 rows), security_factsheet.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally on the DPA and have Marcus attach the SOC 2 summary.

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acehealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo questions: SOC 2 / subprocessors / data residency

Alex / team — quick notes from the compliance side:
- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025 calendar year (Security + Availability). We can share it under a mutual NDA; I'll attach a one-page summary now (SOC2_summary_2025.pdf).
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-compliant deployments via Dedicated/Private and a signed BAA. Our hosted API is not offered for PHI by default — for PHI we require a Private configuration.
- Subprocessor detail: the attached CSV includes a column 'plaintext_token_access' but to be clear: core model inference occurs on our serving runtime (Redwood-managed GPUs). Our telemetry and analytics services only receive metadata (request durations, error codes) — they do not receive full prompt text unless customers opt-in to share eval data. We can redact or provide row-level confirmation for any vendor you flag.
- DPA/DPA template: we use a standard DPA and can provide a draft (DPA_template_v1.docx). Vanessa, can Legal Ops weigh in on any special language AceHealth requires?

Action items:
- Priyom: please review the CSV and confirm which vendors require additional scoping (e.g., cloud storage providers, monitoring).
- Vanessa: hold a placeholder for DPA negotiation / SOW redlines.
- Alex / AceHealth: please send the questionnaire to security-requests@redwood.com and cc lauren.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_summary_2025.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Applied ML Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Thanks Lauren / Marcus — that helps a lot. A couple of quick clarifications before we route to procurement/legal:
1) For the subprocessors CSV, can you mark which vendors operate in eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 vs us-east-1? We specifically need to know the cloud infra mapping for any service that could hold persisted data.
2) Can you confirm whether telemetry/analytics are ever configured to capture full prompt content for customers by default or only if the customer opts in? (You mentioned opt-in — please confirm default is no).
3) Please send the DPA template and a redacted SOC 2 under NDA to legalops@acehealth.com. Our legal team will propose redlines if needed.

We should be able to complete the questionnaire quickly once we get the marked CSV and SOC2. Two windows that work for a follow-up call: 12/02 10:00–10:30 PT or 12/03 13:00–13:30 PT.

—Alex
